events.name: Bash
events.head: Read the capture tool header and command list
events.input: $ wc -l app/scripts/shots/claude-app-shots.py && sed -n 1,60p app/scripts/shots/claude-app-shots.py && grep -n "^def \|add_parser\|argv" app/scripts/shots/claude-app-shots.py | head -40

events.name: Bash
events.head: Find the open capture slots, guide checker and ledger tail
events.input: $ grep -rn "capture_needed" app/src/lib/guides/s6-growth/s6-ai-newsletter.ts app/src/lib/guides/s5-pipeline/s5-follow-ups.ts app/src/lib/guides/s5-pipeline/s5-crm-starter.ts | cut -c1-260; ls app/scripts | grep -i guide; tail -15 scripts/walkthroughs/REVERT_LEDGER.md | cut -c1-200

events.name: Bash
events.head: Read the rest of the tool, locate guide files, show parent process
events.input: $ sed -n 60,130p app/scripts/shots/claude-app-shots.py; grep -rln "s6-ai-newsletter" app/src --include=*.ts | head -5; ps -o pid,ppid,comm -p $$ -p $PPID | cut -c1-150

events.name: Bash
events.head: Test window capture, a read-only System Events query, and the accessibility flag per Python
events.input: $ cd /tmp && which -a python3 | head; T=$(mktemp -d); /usr/sbin/screencapture -x -o -l 6880 $T/w.png 2>&1 | head -3; ls -la $T | tail -1; echo "--- SE"; (osascript -e 'with timeout of 8 seconds' -e 'tell application "System Events" to tell process "Claude" to get name of every menu bar item of menu bar 1' -e 'end timeout' 2>&1 & p=$!; (sleep 12; kill $p 2>/dev/null) & wait $p) | cut -c1-300; echo "--- AX per python"; for p in $(which -a python3) /usr/bin/python3; do $p -c "

events.head: Check event-posting access, read the TCC grants list, and downscale the test capture

events.name: Bash
events.head: Bring Claude forward, list on-screen windows and lock state, take a full-screen capture

events.name: Bash
events.head: Show when the screen locked and the process chain of this run
events.input: $ date -r 1791643925 "+locked since %Y-%m-%d %H:%M %Z"; p=$$; for i in 1 2 3 4 5 6 7; do ps -o pid=,ppid=,comm= -p $p | cut -c1-170; p=$(ps -o ppid= -p $p | tr -d ' '); [ "$p" -le 1 ] && break; done; pmset -g | grep -E "displaysleep| sleep " | head -3

events.text:
T-132 is still blocked: none of the 5 screenshots were captured, because the Mac is on its lock screen and Accessibility is not granted to the runner.

COMPLETION CHECK
- **All 5 slots show a real, redacted capture:** not done. The screen has been locked since 20:22 IST, so both the Claude window and a full-screen capture came back as the lock wallpaper or blank.
- **check-guides capture-needed drops by 5:** not done, since no slot was filled. I did not run check-guides.
- **The demo routine is deleted:** nothing to delete. No routine was created, and the revert ledger needs no entry.
- **Orchestrator note F-a48458c6 ("permission granted and verified"):** only half holds for this run. Screen Recording is in place, but the preflight still reports Accessibility as not granted and a System Events query timed out. Note acked.
- **Capture tool:** `app/scripts/shots/claude-app-shots.py` now detects a locked screen in both `preflight` and `shot` (commit 8b554b1). I ran both: preflight prints `NOT READY`, and `shot` refuses to save a blank image.

Needed from Adi, both on this Mac:
1. Unlock the screen and leave it unlocked with the Claude app open.
2. In System Settings, Privacy and Security, Accessibility, switch on "Python" (`/Library/Frameworks/Python.framework/Versions/3.12/Resources/Python.app`), adding it with the + button if it is not listed.

Once preflight prints READY, the agent can capture all 5 slots without further input.
